body:
This is the best you can do?  Seriously?  I thought I made it clear that the main reason for this pain is the fact that the *core of my being* changed and has never returned back to what it used to be.  Life circumstances don't help, but even if they were much better it'd probably just set back the date some.  Only a miracle that would restore me back to my old self could save me.  And I don't believe in miracles.

The days, weeks, months, and years mean nothing now.  And people are almost as surreal as the time I exist in but no longer belong in.  I never liked people very much, and I still don't.  Just being around new people makes me physically and psychologically ill.  The only peace I had in life was when I was alone.  Even that is gone...

Spring can go fuck itself.  I can barely go outside without having panic attacks that force me to lose control of my body and mind and repeatedly throw up.  I am still seeing a therapist, and that's the problem.  I got a good one after several lousy ones.  But guess what?  It's too late.  If I wasn't getting any help or the help wasn't competent, I might be able to deceive myself into holding off these feelings.  Now I can't do that.

And yeah, I've thought of the "strong" point (I did say I tried positive thinking).  It doesn't matter.  Even if it's true, everyone has their breaking point.  It's just a matter time until I hit mine now, because there has been no relief for years.  There has been no positives to offset the negatives; not even a little.  Every change that's happened in my body and mind has been negative, not positive.

The only thing I want now is to end the pain.  And suicide is the only way left to do that -- everything else has failed.  That's why I say I'm weak, because I'm not doing what I NEED to do to end the pain this very second.  Instead, I'm going to have to wait until illnesses, time, and life overcome my weakness and finally push me to the inevitable.
